items.title: Approve the Minutes of the March 14, 2023 Meeting
Adopt the Recommendations of the Caltrain 22nd Street Station ADA Access Improvement Feasibility Study for the Preferred Improvements to Achieve Street to Platform Accessibility
Allocate $16,406,910 and Appropriate $687,236 in Prop K Funds, with Conditions, and Allocate $2,882,492 in Prop AA Funds for 23 Requests
Allocate Prop K Funds for Downtown Rail Extension Engineering Development; Procurement Preparation; Program Oversight and Technical Tasks; and Pre-Environmental Bridging Study
Award a Construction Contract to Golden State Bridge/Obayashi Joint Venture; Approve a Contract Amendments with WMH Corporation and WSP USA, Inc.
